skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-chordless-cycle
skills.description: Find finite two-section chordless-cycle obstructions and retain an exact witness when one exists.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-perfect-elimination
skills.description: Check a finite two-section graph for an exact perfect-elimination order without promoting the result beyond the declared model.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-clique-conformality
skills.description: Audit whether every maximal clique of a declared finite two-section is covered by a hyperedge.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-gyo-trace
skills.description: Produce and verify a bounded Graham-Yu-Ozsoyoglu reduction trace for a declared finite hypergraph.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-join-tree
skills.description: Construct or reject a finite join-tree certificate and preserve running-intersection evidence.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-running-intersection
skills.description: Audit a proposed finite join tree vertex by vertex with exact connectedness checks.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-alpha-equivalence
skills.description: Compare bounded alpha-acyclicity characterizations and retain disagreements as failures.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-edge-profile
skills.description: Enumerate exact alpha-acyclicity results over nonempty edge-induced subhypergraphs.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-vertex-profile
skills.description: Enumerate exact alpha-acyclicity results over vertex-induced restrictions.

skills.name: ghc-family-acyclicity-edge-deletion
skills.description: Record exact single-edge deletion effects for a finite hypergraph.
